title: Application for temporary injunction (O39 R1 & 2 CPC)

entries.averment: A prima facie case is pleaded as a separately headed paragraph.

source.ref: Dalpat Kumar v. Prahlad Singh (three-limb test)

entries.averment: The balance of convenience is pleaded as a separately headed paragraph.
Irreparable injury (not compensable in money) is pleaded as a separately headed paragraph.
The prayer identifies the specific act sought to be restrained (a bare 'restrain the defendant' is insufficient).

source.ref: O39 R1 & 2 CPC; specificity of relief

entries.averment: The applicant gives an undertaking as to damages.
For ex-parte relief, a paragraph under the proviso to O39 R3 states the urgency and why notice would defeat the purpose of the application.
